name: png_pixel_probe
description: PNG pixel probe for VR screenshot audits: decodes an 8-bit non-interlaced PNG (zlib built-in), then either (a) renders a downsampled ASCII luminance view of a crop so the auditor can see whether text/UI is clipped or occluded, or (b) returns crop statistics (mean luma, clipped-white fraction, per-channel means, row/column ink profiles). Called when judging screenshot craft claims (white-clip, text

file.description: path to the PNG relative to the working folder
